affected_party: Organizations and AI/human teams that need to evaluate quality without relying on volume metrics or undocumented veteran judgment
actual_problem: The discovered quality theory is currently conceptual; it lacks canonical entities, schemas, workflows, evidence rules, confidence calculation, verdict production, and governance lifecycle needed for AI-verifiable operation.
why_it_matters: Without an operational framework, organizations may confuse activity counts with quality, lose tacit quality knowledge, or let AI agents make unverifiable quality judgments.
why_now: The repository is being established as the Quality Intent Framework managed project and needs its first executable specification baseline.
